question: What is the main focus of dietetics as a practical science?

options.A: Conducting agricultural research on crop yield improvement
options.B: Turning nutrition science into real, everyday eating plans
options.C: Studying the molecular structure of synthetic proteins
options.D: Manufacturing pharmaceutical supplements for hospital use

explanation: Dietetics takes the science of how the body uses food and turns it into practical meal plans that people can actually use in real life. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h1)

question: Why do dietitians need to understand human behavior along with food science?

options.A: Food chemistry changes completely based on the patient's mood
options.B: Patients need to feel understood in their cultural and personal habits to follow meal plans
options.C: Biochemical data alone is enough to change eating habits permanently
options.D: Psychological evaluations are legally required before writing a hospital diet

explanation: Knowing the science of food is only half the battle! If a patient's personal or cultural beliefs clash with the diet, they won't be able to follow it. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h1)

question: What is the main difference between nutrition and dietetics?

options.A: Nutrition applies only to sick patients, while dietetics applies to healthy people
options.B: Dietetics focuses only on food production, while nutrition focuses on medicine
options.C: Nutrition is the study of food, while dietetics is how we apply it to help people
options.D: There is no difference and the two terms mean the exact same thing

explanation: Think of nutrition as the science behind food, and dietetics as putting that science into action for patient care. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h2)

question: A researcher is studying how calcium is absorbed in the small intestine. Which field are they working in?
explanation: Studying how the body processes and absorbs specific nutrients falls right under the science of nutrition! [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h2)

question: Who on the healthcare team is the go-to expert for designing specialized medical nutrition therapy?
explanation: Dietitians have specialized training to create specific medical nutrition plans for patients with complex health needs. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h3)

question: Why is teamwork between a dietitian and a pharmacist so important for patient safety?

options.A: To calculate the exact financial cost of hospital meal trays
options.B: To determine when the patient is ready for hospital discharge
options.C: To decide which nurse will feed the patient during the shift
options.D: To prevent bad interactions between food and prescribed drugs

explanation: Certain foods can block or dangerously increase how medications work, making a joint review by dietitians and pharmacists super important. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h3)

question: Where would you usually find a clinical dietitian doing their daily work?

options.C: At a national agricultural trade ministry
options.D: Writing policy for a food manufacturing plant

explanation: Clinical dietitians work hand-in-hand with individual patients right inside healthcare facilities like hospitals and clinics. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h4)

question: A nurse is helping design a public health program to tackle malnutrition in local primary schools. Which type of dietitian should lead this?
explanation: Community dietitians focus on public health, schools, and larger group or population-wide nutrition programs. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h4)

question: Why must diet care in Nigeria make use of local staples like garri, beans, and yams?

options.A: Because local staples contain zero carbohydrates and cannot raise blood sugar
options.B: To make sure the meal advice is affordable, practical, and fits the patient's culture
options.C: Because imported foreign foods are illegal to prescribe in government hospitals
options.D: To prevent the Ministry of Health from auditing the hospital kitchen

explanation: Patients find it much easier to stick to meal plans when they use foods they already know, buy, and love eating every day. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h5)

question: What is the double nutritional challenge facing the Nigerian healthcare system today?

options.A: Complete absence of nutritional disorders in urban and rural areas
options.B: Only severe protein deficiency with zero cases of chronic illness
options.C: Strictly overnutrition and obesity with no forms of hunger
options.D: Dealing with undernutrition while also seeing a rise in chronic lifestyle diseases

explanation: Nigeria faces a double burden: fighting traditional issues like hunger and malnutrition while also managing lifestyle illnesses like diabetes and high blood pressure. [learn more](GNS227_U4_T001#GNS227_U4_T001_h5)
